name: @retroplug/midi
description: The host's MIDI: one interface a backend fills (MidiBackend / MidiPort), RtMidi as the real one and an in-process fake for tests, the one MIDI stream the SDL app's audio loop and the CLI's facet share, one copy of the port filters (isHardwareMidiPort, the test-only RP_MIDI_PORT_ALLOW list), and the midi facet as a package provider with an rpc.
